SYNTHETIC test fixture in llama.cpp --help format (not a real capture). Represents a NEW build:
the no-mmap and draft options are removed, load-mode and spec-type added, f8_e4m3 added to the cache types.

----- common params -----

-h,    --help, --usage                  print usage and exit
-t,    --threads N                      number of CPU threads to use during generation (default: -1)
                                        (env: LLAMA_ARG_THREADS)
-c,    --ctx-size N                     size of the prompt context (default: 4096)
-b,    --batch-size N                   logical maximum batch size (default: 2048)
-ub,   --ubatch-size N                  physical maximum batch size (default: 512)
-fa,   --flash-attn [on|off|auto]       set Flash Attention use ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto')
-ctk,  --cache-type-k TYPE              KV cache data type for K
                                        allowed values: f32, f16, bf16, f8_e4m3, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl,
                                        q5_0, q5_1
                                        (default: f16)
-ctv,  --cache-type-v TYPE              KV cache data type for V
                                        allowed values: f32, f16, bf16, f8_e4m3, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl, q5_0, q5_1
                                        (default: f16)
-lm,   --load-mode {mmap,none,dio}      how to load the model (default: mmap)
-ngl,  --gpu-layers, --n-gpu-layers N   max. number of layers to store in VRAM, a number, 'auto' or 'all'
-ncmoe, --n-cpu-moe N                   keep the MoE weights of the first N layers in the CPU
--spec-type TYPE                        speculative decoding types
                                        allowed values: draft-simple, draft-mtp, ngram-cache, ngram-mod
--spec-draft-n-max N                    number of tokens to draft (default: 3)
-md,   --model-draft FNAME              draft model path
-m,    --model FNAME                    model path
--jinja, --no-jinja                     whether to use jinja template engine for chat (default: enabled)
--temp N                                temperature (default: 0.8)
--top-k N                               top-k sampling (default: 40)
--top-p N                               top-p sampling (default: 0.95)
-rf,   --reasoning-format FORMAT        controls whether thought tags are allowed and/or extracted
--host HOST                             ip address to listen (default: 127.0.0.1)
--port PORT                             port to listen (default: 9931)
-np,   --parallel N                     number of server slots (default: -1)
